playstyle: Back to basics with a deadly full-crouch mix-up. Get into a crouch and threaten his Slide (FC.df,d,DF+3), arguably the best power low in the game (Wavu), against his crouching mids. Use Stealth Step (SNK) transitions to keep the turn. From standing his lows are only average, so keep-out characters can give him trouble.

stances.name: Stealth Step
stances.entry: DF after 3, 2,3, d+3 and others; the Slide transitions on hit
stances.note: SNK.2 and SNK.df+1,2 are used in his combos; SNK.1 is a counter-hit tool (Wavu).
